openstreetmap.fiction_separation: Source-derived geographic data stays in data/geography; fictional names, events, actors and transformations belong in a distinct world layer.
openstreetmap.redistribution: Raw OSM response and OSM-derived GeoJSON remain under ODbL 1.0. Preserve attribution and share-alike database obligations.
openstreetmap.use: Few bounded offline acquisition requests; not a production backend, tile scraper or planet-ingestion route.
